d:
The LG OLED evo G6 is LG's latest flagship OLED TV, and it brings quite a bit to the table. The Hyper Radiant Colour Tech display really stands out, especially when paired with the new Alpha 11 AI Processor Gen3 that LG says pushes peak brightness up by nearly 4 times.
There's also a bunch of AI built into the experience. You can search using either Google Gemini or Microsoft Copilot right from the remote, and the TV even recognises different family members through AI Voice ID so everyone gets their own personalised setup.
